title: Update Sketchpad Detail Panel From Repo Changes
description: Update Sketchpad Detail Panel From Repo Changes
summary: Fixed the JSX parsing error causing compose play to not start. The error was due to a malformed and duplicated `TreeAlignedRow` block caused by a botched git merge in `elements/ui/index.tsx`, resulting in an unclosed `<div>`. Removed the duplicated logic and reconstructed the fallback logic correctly without missing tags.
